look_here_first: Slender yellow-flowered bladderpod distinguished by recurved fruiting structures and inflated capsules.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Brassicaceae bladderpod group: 4-petaled yellow flowers, stellate hairs common, and inflated silicles/capsules; habit, hair density, pedicel posture, and fruit shape are important for ID.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: fruiting pedicels or fruits characteristically recurved

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: dry prairie or rocky open habitat

lookalikes.differences: The name is the memory cue: recurvata = recurved. Look for backward-curving fruiting posture rather than the straighter fruit stalks of P. gracilis.
